第39章 居然是AWM-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

八点三十分。

距离会议开始还有半个小时。

两人穿过两条街道，来到工地外围。

工地的蓝色铁皮围挡大门紧锁，顾承安看了一眼四周，走到围挡的一个角落。

那里的铁皮有一道不显眼的缝隙，边缘的泥土有被踩踏过的痕迹。

很新。

顾承安打了个手势，陆鸣会意，拔出配枪，打开保险。

两人顺着缝隙钻进工地。

楼栋内部光线昏暗，到处是散落的砖块、水泥袋和木板。

天珠的探测范围是十米，顾承安必须一层一层地往上爬。

这栋楼一共二十八层。

“分头？”陆鸣轻声问道。

“不，一起。”

顾承安没有解释原因。

两人沿着没有护栏的水泥现浇楼梯，放轻脚步，快速向上巡查。

五层，十层，十五层。

顾承安的呼吸依然平稳，他不断地在脑海中计算角度。

会议中心的广场在东南面，要获得最佳的俯射角度，狙击手一定会选择二十层以上的东南角位置。

二十层，手机没动静。

二十二层，没动静。

二十四层。

顾承安停下脚步，贴在楼梯间的墙壁上。

他抬起手，示意陆鸣停止前进。

顾承安自从基因优化完成后，直觉就变得非常灵敏。

这层楼，他感觉不太一样。

顾承安轻轻摸出手机，看了一眼屏幕。

依然没有告警，说明目标还在十米之外。

这层楼的面积很大，从楼梯间到东南角的窗户，直线距离大约有三十米。

顾承安探出半个头，飞快地扫了一眼，缩回。

东南角的承重柱后面，隐约露出一截伪装过的枪管，枪口探出没有玻璃的窗框，正对着会议中心的方向。

找到了。

二十四层，风很大，穿堂风呼啸着掠过空荡荡的水泥楼板，掩盖了细微的脚步声。

顾承安缩回墙后，冲陆鸣打了个战术手势：目标在十点钟方向，承重柱后，距离三十米。

陆鸣点头，握紧了手里的九二式。

Eight-thirty.

There is still half an hour before the meeting starts.

The two crossed two streets and came to the outskirts of the construction site.

The blue iron fence door at the construction site was locked. Gu Chengan glanced around and walked to a corner of the fence.

There is an inconspicuous gap in the iron sheet there, and the soil on the edge has traces of being stepped on.

Very new.

Gu Chengan made a gesture, and Lu Ming understood, pulled out his gun and turned on the safety.

The two got into the construction site along the gap.

The interior of the building is dimly lit, with bricks, cement bags and wooden boards scattered everywhere.

The detection range of the Dzi Bead is ten meters, and Gu Chengan has to climb up layer by layer.

This building has a total of twenty-eight floors.

"Split up?" Lu Ming asked softly.

"No, together."

Gu Chengan did not explain the reason.

The two walked slowly along the cast-in-place concrete stairs without guardrails, and quickly inspected upwards.

Five floors, ten floors, fifteen floors.

Gu Chengan's breathing was still steady, and he kept calculating the angles in his mind.

The square of the conference center is in the southeast. To get the best shooting angle, the sniper will definitely choose the southeast corner above the 20th floor.

On the twentieth floor, the phone was silent.

On the twenty-second floor, there was no movement.

Twenty-four floors.

Gu Chengan stopped and pressed against the wall of the stairwell.

He raised his hand to signal Lu Ming to stop moving forward.

Since the completion of genetic optimization, Gu Chengan's intuition has become very sensitive.

He felt something was different on this floor.

Gu Chengan gently took out his phone and glanced at the screen.

There was still no alarm, indicating that the target was still ten meters away.

This floor is very large, with a straight line distance of about thirty meters from the stairwell to the southeast corner window.

Gu Chengan stuck out half of his head, took a quick glance, and then retracted.

Behind the load-bearing pillar in the southeast corner, a camouflaged gun barrel was vaguely exposed. The muzzle of the gun poked out of the glassless window frame, facing the direction of the conference center.

Found it.

On the twenty-fourth floor, the wind was very strong, and the draft blew across the empty concrete floor, covering up the subtle footsteps.

Gu Chengan retracted behind the wall and made a tactical gesture to Lu Ming: the target is at ten o'clock, behind the load-bearing pillar, thirty meters away.

Lu Ming nodded and clenched the Ninety-two Style in his hand.
